_comment: 'If the defending hero has 1 or more cards in their soul, this gets go again.' The condition was already authored correctly (SOUL_COUNT_GTE against a real soul zone); only the SHAPE was wrong. A TRIGGERED grant is invisible to loader.conditional_keywords, which strips a printed keyword only for a SOURCE_IS_ATTACK-gated ability -- so the printed GoAgain stayed unconditional and the card had go again even against an empty soul. WHILE_STATIC per CR 6.2.3d: the condition is evaluated at all times, which matters here because a soul can be filled or emptied mid-chain and go again is paid at the Resolution Step (8.3.5b).
